commits.message:
decodeAnsi ends a line at CNL as at NEL, once whatever its count; CPL stays dropped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.llj) (#578)

* decodeAnsi ends a line at CNL as at NEL, once per row it moves down; CPL stays dropped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.llj)

* CNL ends a line once whatever its count; the docs gate counts CNL and ESC E as drawn (rich-control-codes-xh4n.llj)

High review: a count invented rows no terminal draws (999E, a CPL/CNL redraw). With no screen height, a count is unknowable; one break is NEL's meaning.

* CNL's rule rests on the decoder holding no cursor row; the docs gate reads LINE_BREAK_ESCAPES (rich-control-codes-xh4n.llj)

Medium review: the bottom-row argument was backwards (CNL never scrolls). DRAWN no longer copies the line-break pattern, and a test pins CNL and ESC E as drawn, CPL dropped. decodeLine's CNL drop is documented beside its form-feed drop.
